notes:
Group C infrastructure ministries (Railways, Road Transport & Highways, Civil Aviation, Ports Shipping & Waterways, Housing & Urban Affairs, Jal Shakti, Communications). Cabinet/MoS minister positions themselves (in-pos-minister-*, in-pos-mos-*) are owned by the council-of-ministers segment and are only referenced here via headPositionId, not defined. Regulators TRAI/AERA (regulators segment) and tribunal TDSAT (judiciary segment) are referenced in relations, not redefined, per ownership rules.

KNOWN GAPS / LOW-CONFIDENCE ITEMS (holder not confirmed against a 2025-2026 source at research time; position included per quality-bar instructions with confidence=low, holder=null):
- All 12 Major Port Authority Chairmen (Deendayal, Mumbai, JNPA, Mormugao, New Mangalore, Cochin, Chennai, V.O. Chidambaranar, Visakhapatnam, Paradip, Syama Prasad Mookerjee) and Kamarajar Port CMD.
- DFCCIL Managing Director.
- NHSRCL Managing Director: Wikipedia infobox names Vivek Kumar Gupta, who is also the sitting Railway Board Member (Infrastructure) per the official 28-07-2026 roster -- likely stale/conflicting; unresolved.
- Pawan Hans CMD, IAHE Director General, CGWB Chairman, NMCG Director General, Brahmaputra Board Chairman, NWDA Director General, WAPCOS CMD, CPWD Director General (only 'additional charge' name found), RLDA Vice Chairman.
- Secretaries: Ports Shipping & Waterways; Water Resources/Ganga Rejuvenation; Drinking Water & Sanitation -- not found via Wikipedia/available sources in the time available; official ministry 'About Us' pages returned errors/403s during research.
- Zonal-railway General Manager postings rotate frequently (officers were being reshuffled through 2026); all 18 GM names are sourced from the indianrailways.gov.in Board Members/General Managers page with 'Last Reviewed 28-07-2026' -- the single most authoritative and current source found, but should be re-checked close to publish since postings can change within weeks.
- MTNL is shown with the same CMD as BSNL (A. Robert J. Ravi) reflecting BSNL's absorption of MTNL management; the formal legal-merger status of MTNL into BSNL was not independently confirmed here.
- Budget figures were intentionally omitted (union-budget segment owns all budget numbers).
- WebSearch quota was exhausted mid-research (shared session budget across parallel research segments); remaining research relied on WebFetch (Wikipedia parse API, official portals) and curl+python only, which limited cross-verification depth on some low-confidence items above.

entities.name: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

entities.name: National Highways Authority of India
entities.description: Statutory body that develops, maintains and manages India's National Highways network (50,000+ km), including via the Bharatmala programme and toll (FASTag) operations.
entities.legalBasis: National Highways Authority of India Act, 1988

entities.name: National Highways and Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited
entities.description: CPSU developing and maintaining national highways in border, hilly, Northeast and island regions where NHAI does not operate.

entities.name: Indian Academy of Highway Engineers
entities.description: MoRTH's apex training institute for highway engineers, based in Noida, delivering technical and managerial training to central and state highway engineering staff.

entities.name: Ministry of Civil Aviation
entities.description: Formulates policy for civil aviation, airport infrastructure, air-safety and air-transport regulation, including the UDAN regional connectivity scheme.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Directorate General of Civil Aviation
entities.description: Statutory air-safety regulator: licenses pilots and aviation personnel, certifies aircraft airworthiness, and investigates regulatory compliance across Indian civil aviation.

entities.name: Bureau of Civil Aviation Security
entities.description: Regulates and enforces aviation-security standards at Indian airports and for Indian aircraft operators.

entities.name: Airports Authority of India
entities.description: Statutory body that builds, upgrades, maintains and manages civil aviation infrastructure and provides air navigation services (air traffic control) over Indian airspace; operates most non-privatised Indian airports.
entities.hq: Rajiv Gandhi Bhawan, Safdarjung Airport, New Delhi

entities.name: Pawan Hans Limited
entities.description: Government helicopter service provider for offshore oil-rig logistics, inter-island transport, heli-tourism and charter operations; Miniratna-I category PSU under the Ministry of Civil Aviation.

entities.name: Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau
entities.description: Independent accident-investigation body for Indian civil-aircraft accidents and serious incidents, separate from the safety regulator DGCA.

entities.name: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
entities.description: Formulates policy for major ports, shipping, ship-building, inland waterways and the Sagarmala port-led development programme.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Deendayal Port Authority
entities.description: One of India's 11 statutory Major Port Authorities (plus Kamarajar Port as a corporatised 12th major port), located at Kandla, Gujarat; governs port land, tariffs and operations under the Major Port Authorities Act.

entities.name: Mumbai Port Authority
entities.description: One of India's 11 statutory Major Port Authorities (plus Kamarajar Port as a corporatised 12th major port), located at Mumbai, Maharashtra; governs port land, tariffs and operations under the Major Port Authorities Act.

entities.name: Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority
entities.description: One of India's 11 statutory Major Port Authorities (plus Kamarajar Port as a corporatised 12th major port), located at Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra; governs port land, tariffs and operations under the Major Port Authorities Act.

entities.name: Mormugao Port Authority
entities.description: One of India's 11 statutory Major Port Authorities (plus Kamarajar Port as a corporatised 12th major port), located at Mormugao, Goa; governs port land, tariffs and operations under the Major Port Authorities Act.

entities.name: New Mangalore Port Authority
entities.description: One of India's 11 statutory Major Port Authorities (plus Kamarajar Port as a corporatised 12th major port), located at Mangaluru, Karnataka; governs port land, tariffs and operations under the Major Port Authorities Act.

entities.name: Cochin Port Authority
entities.description: One of India's 11 statutory Major Port Authorities (plus Kamarajar Port as a corporatised 12th major port), located at Kochi, Kerala; governs port land, tariffs and operations under the Major Port Authorities Act.

entities.name: Chennai Port Authority
entities.description: One of India's 11 statutory Major Port Authorities (plus Kamarajar Port as a corporatised 12th major port), located at Chennai, Tamil Nadu; governs port land, tariffs and operations under the Major Port Authorities Act.

entities.name: V.O. Chidambaranar Port Authority
entities.description: One of India's 11 statutory Major Port Authorities (plus Kamarajar Port as a corporatised 12th major port), located at Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu; governs port land, tariffs and operations under the Major Port Authorities Act.

entities.name: Visakhapatnam Port Authority
entities.description: One of India's 11 statutory Major Port Authorities (plus Kamarajar Port as a corporatised 12th major port), located at Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh; governs port land, tariffs and operations under the Major Port Authorities Act.

entities.name: Paradip Port Authority
entities.description: One of India's 11 statutory Major Port Authorities (plus Kamarajar Port as a corporatised 12th major port), located at Paradip, Odisha; governs port land, tariffs and operations under the Major Port Authorities Act.

entities.name: Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port Authority
entities.description: One of India's 11 statutory Major Port Authorities (plus Kamarajar Port as a corporatised 12th major port), located at Kolkata, West Bengal (incl. Haldia Dock); governs port land, tariffs and operations under the Major Port Authorities Act.

entities.name: Kamarajar Port Limited
entities.description: India's 12th major port and the only one structured as a corporatised company (rather than a statutory port authority); located at Ennore, Tamil Nadu.

entities.name: Directorate General of Shipping
entities.description: Maritime administration regulating Indian-flag shipping, seafarer certification, ship safety and India's compliance with international maritime conventions.

entities.name: Inland Waterways Authority of India
entities.description: Statutory body developing and maintaining India's National Waterways for inland shipping and navigation.
entities.legalBasis: Inland Waterways Authority of India Act, 1985

entities.name: Shipping Corporation of India Limited
entities.description: Listed PSU operating India's largest shipping fleet across bulk, tanker, container and offshore-support segments; long-pending strategic-disinvestment candidate.

entities.name: Cochin Shipyard Limited
entities.description: Listed Miniratna PSU and India's largest shipyard; built INS Vikrant (India's first indigenous aircraft carrier) and undertakes ship-building, ship-repair and offshore-platform work.

entities.name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
entities.description: Formulates urban-development policy: housing, urban transport, urban planning, water/sanitation missions and central public-works construction.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Central Public Works Department
entities.description: India's oldest central construction agency; designs, builds and maintains government buildings and central-government civil infrastructure nationwide.

entities.name: NBCC (India) Limited
entities.description: Wholly government-owned, listed Navratna PSU providing project-management-consultancy, EPC construction and real-estate development/redevelopment services.

entities.name: Housing and Urban Development Corporation Limited
entities.description: Listed Navratna PSU providing long-term finance for housing and urban-infrastructure projects (water supply, sanitation, urban transport).

entities.name: Delhi Development Authority
entities.description: Statutory planning and land-development authority for the National Capital Territory of Delhi; controls land acquisition, master planning and housing schemes in Delhi.

entities.name: National Capital Region Transport Corporation
entities.description: Joint-venture company implementing the Regional Rapid Transit System (Namo Bharat/RapidX) connecting Delhi to NCR towns; jointly owned by the Union and the NCR states.

entities.name: Delhi Metro Rail Corporation
entities.description: 50:50 Union-Delhi joint-venture company that built and operates the Delhi Metro and, under contract/consultancy, other city metros (Noida, Rapid Metro Gurgaon) in India and abroad.

entities.name: Hindustan Prefab Limited
entities.description: Small Central PSU under MoHUA engaged in prefabricated-construction technology and building-materials manufacturing.

entities.name: Smart Cities Mission
entities.description: Flagship urban-development mission (100 selected cities) funding smart-infrastructure, ICT-enabled services and area-based redevelopment through city-level Special Purpose Vehicles.

entities.name: AMRUT (Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation)
entities.description: Mission funding basic urban infrastructure — water supply, sewerage, stormwater drainage, green spaces — in mission cities; AMRUT 2.0 launched 2021 targets universal water coverage.

entities.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban
entities.description: Central affordable-housing mission for urban poor and middle-income households via credit-linked subsidy, in-situ slum redevelopment, and beneficiary-led construction; PMAY-U 2.0 launched thereafter.

entities.name: Swachh Bharat Mission - Urban
entities.description: Urban sanitation mission for open-defecation-free cities and scientific solid/liquid waste management, run in parallel with the rural SBM-Gramin under Jal Shakti.

entities.name: Ministry of Jal Shakti
entities.description: Umbrella water ministry combining water-resources/river management with rural and urban drinking-water and sanitation policy, through its two constituent departments.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961 (ministry formed 2019)

entities.name: Department of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation
entities.description: Handles national water-resources policy, inter-state river-water matters, irrigation/flood-management coordination, and the Namami Gange programme for Ganga rejuvenation.

entities.name: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation
entities.description: Runs national rural drinking-water and sanitation policy, chiefly through the Jal Jeevan Mission and Swachh Bharat Mission-Gramin.

entities.name: Central Water Commission
entities.description: India's premier technical organisation on water resources; advises on irrigation, flood control, hydropower and inter-state river schemes.
entities.hq: Sewa Bhawan, R.K. Puram, New Delhi

entities.name: Central Ground Water Board
entities.description: Scientific agency responsible for groundwater resource assessment, monitoring, exploration and regulation across India.

entities.name: National Mission for Clean Ganga
entities.description: Implementation arm (registered society) of the Namami Gange programme for pollution abatement, conservation and rejuvenation of the Ganga river.
entities.legalBasis: Registered society; statutory powers from National Ganga River Basin Authority order under the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986

entities.name: Brahmaputra Board
entities.description: Statutory body for integrated planning of flood control, drainage and water-resource development in the Brahmaputra and Barak valleys (Assam and neighbouring states).

entities.name: National Water Development Agency
entities.description: Registered society that studies and plans inter-basin water-transfer links under the National Perspective Plan (river-interlinking).

entities.name: WAPCOS Limited
entities.description: Government-owned multidisciplinary consultancy in water-resources, power and infrastructure engineering, working in India and abroad.

entities.name: Jal Jeevan Mission
entities.description: Flagship mission to provide functional household tap-water connections to every rural household; restructured in 2019 from the earlier National Rural Drinking Water Programme.

entities.name: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin
entities.description: Rural arm of the national sanitation campaign launched 2 October 2014, focused on ending open defecation and (in Phase II) solid/liquid waste management in villages.

entities.name: Ministry of Communications
entities.description: Formulates telecommunications and postal policy through its two constituent departments; regulates spectrum, licensing and the national postal network.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Telecommunications
entities.description: Regulates telecom licensing, spectrum allocation/pricing, and oversees BSNL/MTNL and the telecom PSU/R&D ecosystem; secretariat for the (now-dissolved) Digital Communications Commission.

entities.name: Digital Communications Commission
entities.description: DISSOLVED. Formerly the apex inter-departmental decision-making body of DoT (est. 1989 as the Telecom Commission, renamed 2018); held its final meeting 3 September 2026 on satellite-spectrum policy and was dissolved with effect from 19 September 2026, with its approval functions transferred to the Telecom Secretary, the Minister, or an Expenditure Finance Committee depending on the value involved.

entities.name: Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited
entities.description: State-owned telecom operator providing mobile, landline, broadband and enterprise services nationwide; undergoing 4G/5G revival funded by successive government equity infusions.

entities.name: Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited
entities.description: State-owned telecom operator for Mumbai and Delhi circles; now run under common management with BSNL as part of its revival/merger process.

entities.name: Bharat Broadband Network Limited
entities.description: DEFUNCT. Built India's National Optical Fibre Network (BharatNet) to villages/gram panchayats; merged into BSNL after a Cabinet decision of 27 July 2022 (merger completed later that year).

entities.name: Centre for Development of Telematics
entities.description: Government-owned telecom-technology R&D centre that designs indigenous telecom/networking equipment (e.g. 4G/5G core, GPON) for Indian operators including BSNL.

entities.name: Telecommunication Engineering Centre
entities.description: DoT's technical standards body: sets Generic Requirements and Interface Requirements for telecom equipment and coordinates testing/certification standards.

entities.name: Department of Posts
entities.description: Runs India Post, the country's postal service and (via its Postal Services Board) sets postal policy; operates the world's most extensive post-office network and India Post Payments Bank.
entities.hq: Dak Bhawan, Sansad Marg, New Delhi

entities.name: Postal Services Board
entities.description: Apex decision-making board of the Department of Posts, chaired ex officio by the Secretary (Posts), with Members for operations, personnel, technology and banking.

entities.name: India Post Payments Bank
entities.description: Payments bank wholly owned by the Department of Posts, using the postal network (including postmen/Grameen Dak Sevaks) to deliver banking and financial-inclusion services.

entities.name: Rail Land Development Authority
entities.description: Statutory authority that commercially develops vacant railway land and redevelops railway stations (e.g. New Delhi, Bhopal); absorbed the Indian Railway Stations Development Corporation (IRSDC) in 2022.

entities.name: Central Organisation for Railway Electrification
entities.description: Railway Board's specialised organisation executing electrification of railway routes across all zones.

entities.name: Bharatmala Pariyojana
entities.description: Umbrella national highway-development programme (launched 2017) for economic corridors, inter-corridor/feeder roads, border and coastal roads, and port connectivity, implemented mainly through NHAI.

entities.name: UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik) - Regional Connectivity Scheme
entities.description: Regional Connectivity Scheme (launched 2016) subsidising airlines to fly under-served and unserved routes/airports to make air travel affordable, via viability-gap funding.

entities.name: Sagarmala Programme
entities.description: Flagship port-led development programme (launched 2015) for port modernisation, port connectivity, port-linked industrialisation and coastal community development.

entities.name: Department of Capital Development
entities.description: Carved out of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs in July 2026 to run local capital governance for the National Capital Region, separating it from broader national urban-policy functions.
